description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to plugin updates, including updating plugins via npm, ClawHub, or marketplace, handling plugin configuration migrations, and synchronizing plugin sources with different update channels. It also includes utility functions for path resolution, integrity checks, and error message formatting.

classes.name: PluginUpdateLogger
classes.description: Type defining optional logging functions for plugin update processes.

methods.name: formatNpmInstallFailure
methods.description: Formats error messages for npm installation failures based on error code.

methods.name: formatMarketplaceInstallFailure
methods.description: Formats error messages for marketplace plugin installation failures.

methods.name: formatClawHubInstallFailure
methods.description: Formats error messages for ClawHub plugin installation failures.

methods.name: pathsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two paths are equivalent after resolution.

methods.name: buildLoadPathHelpers
methods.description: Creates helper functions to manage plugin load paths, including adding and removing paths.

methods.name: replacePluginIdInList
methods.description: Replaces a plugin ID with another in a list of plugin IDs.

methods.name: migratePluginConfigId
methods.description: Migrates plugin IDs within the plugin configuration object.

methods.name: createPluginUpdateIntegrityDriftHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler to process integrity drift during plugin updates.

methods.name: updateNpmInstalledPlugins
methods.description: Updates plugins installed via npm, marketplace, or ClawHub, with support for dry runs and integrity checks.

methods.name: syncPluginsForUpdateChannel
methods.description: Synchronizes plugin sources based on the specified update channel, switching between bundled and npm sources.
